title: YESWAY ENTERS ARIZONA WITH GRAND OPENING OF ITS FIRST ALLSUP'S STORE IN THE STATE
summary: Yesway, Inc. (Nasdaq: YSWY), one of the nation's fastest-growing convenience store chains, today announced that it will celebrate the grand opening of its first-ever Allsup's convenience store in Arizona on Friday, October 2, 2026. The opening marks an important milestone in Yesway's history, introducing the iconic Allsup's brand to Arizona for the first time and expanding the company's operating footprint into its 10th state.
